title: triage-report template variables
description: Values for templates/triage-report.md.j2 and templates/triage-report.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from triage-report.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

artefact_date.description: Which day is being triaged, as YYYY-MM-DD? The day the deltas describe, not the day you got round to reading them.

owner_full_name.description: Who ran this triage and owns its decision? One named human - the rota exists so that a `continue` verdict has somebody's name against it.
